description: Serialisation-order and array-order perturbations of bp-two-panels. bp-1.json and bp-2.json are identical to the baseline; canonical-reordered.nt holds exactly the same triples in a different line order; the *-components-reversed.json pair swaps the component array order, which legitimately changes fhir:index and therefore the graph, while leaving the clinical content the same.

same_graph_different_serialisation.assert: parses to exactly the same triple set as canonical.nt, and the extracted tuple multiset is unchanged

different_graph_same_clinical_content.assert: the triple set DIFFERS from canonical.nt (fhir:index moves), and the extracted tuple multiset is nevertheless unchanged, because the components are selected by LOINC code and not by position
